coverage_relation: Regional subset of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland; not its full population
source_title: ONS population estimates for England and Wales, Table 7
source_edition: England and Wales population estimates 1838 to 2025; published 2026-07-29
attribution: Source: Office for National Statistics. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
methodology: Directly extract the published Persons cell for Mid-1900. Retain it as an England and Wales regional reference. Do not allocate it among polygons or scale it to the selected UK boundary.
limitations: Estimate, not an exact census count; displayed rounding does not imply individual-person precision.
The source excludes Islands in the British Seas and portions of the Armed Forces and Merchant Service abroad for 1838–1910.
No admitted population total for the full UK historical territory and no historical density geometry.
This single observation does not establish population for any other date.
